_note: Studies coded for the release in addition to the coded corpus of corpus/eiccam_table_body.tex, with the same coding scheme (FF phenological phase of the irradiated propagule, EP endpoint category). Each carries the doses it irradiated, so that the taxon dose windows classify doses from a source they were not built from.

studies.summary: Five genotypes irradiated at 100 to 1200 Gy in 100 Gy steps, with an unirradiated control; germination LD50 of 531.0 to 903.0 Gy by genotype (Table 1).
